judge.rationale: The candidate's production implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` is clean and functionally sound, wrapping non-Error rejections in an `Error` with `{cause: error}`, stringifying plain objects with a fallback, and re-throwing the original rejection unchanged. It also updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (along with test line references across specs) while leaving existing `Error` tests untouched. However, the candidate misses part of the second acceptance criterion in its tests and spec text: it never tests a rejection with `undefined` and fails to assert `error.cause` on the plain-object rejection test (only checking `cause` on the string case). Additionally, the candidate splits tests across `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and a new `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus leaving `.lore/dod.md`), whereas the reference consolidated all three rejection cases (`string`, `object`, `undefined`) into a single table-driven test inside `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
